b002.speaker: Spider-Man
b002.text: so whoever did this isn't a lethal protector. That's promising.

b007.speaker: Otto
b007.text: This isn't about safety infractions, is it?

b011.speaker: Otto
b011.text: Someday I'll turn the tables. I'll teach Norman what it is to feel helpless and small.

b017.speaker: Jefferson Davis
b017.text: You remind me of my son.

b017.speaker: Jefferson Davis
b017.text: Started taking apart the TV when he was five.

b017.speaker: Jefferson Davis
b017.text: Now he's unlocking his friends' phones.

b020.speaker: Wilson Fisk
b020.text: One month! In one month you'll wish you had me back!

b022.speaker: Spider-Man
b022.text: Wait, what's that feeling? Do I...

b024.speaker: Spider-Man
b024.text: A vacuum I created by putting Fisk away.

b024.speaker: Spider-Man
b024.text: Jameson was right, the Demons are my fault.

b028.speaker: Martin Li
b028.text: Now it's you who inspires me.

b030.speaker: Aunt May
b030.text: I think you remind him of himself when he was younger.
